scientific_integrity: The finite-growth global attraction is credited to Ishihara and Nakata. The singular six-resonance limit is proved by an analytic Lyapunov--Schmidt reduction. Computations only check finite cases; there is no independent audit or external priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The scaled forcing eta is held fixed as the growth factor tends to infinity; no simultaneous eta-growth limit.
No estimate of the attraction transient uniform in growth factor is proved.
Two plausibly adjacent delayed-cycle articles were not accessible in continuous full text; independent historical priority comparison remains outstanding.
title: Nonlinear six-season resonance selection in the delayed Beverton--Holt map
